========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu: Yodl Buffer Over-Read         
                                        
  Maliciously crafted document input    
  triggers an out-of-bounds read error  
  during parsing, crashing the Yodl     
  utility in a denial-of-service state. 
  Upgrade yodl packages on Ubuntu hosts 
  immediately.                          
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
